description: RCMDM 7th Regular meeting in RY 2026-27 at residence of Bharti and Dilip Gurjar at Bhimrao Wadi, Thakurdwar, Mumbai 400002 with a single point agenda to approve an ELECTOR to vote for DGNG-2029-30 election of RID 3141 and to decide which candidate to support and vote for amongst the 2 candidates standing for the post. The meeting started after high tea and snacks and after the 4th BOD Meeting and then was followed by vote of thanks and adjourned. Unanimous decision was taken on the matter deliberated.
